newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-HORNETS C DIVAC UNDERGOES SUCCESSFUL WRIST SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-HORNETS C DIVAC UNDERGOES SUCCESSFUL WRIST SURGERY.

text.p: Charlotte Hornets centre Vlade Divac underwent successful surgery Thursday to repair torn ligaments in his left wrist.
Divac will be in a half-cast for three to four weeks to keep the wrist immobilized and can begin shooting in six to eight weeks, the team said.
The 7-1 (2.16 m) Divac averaged 12.6 points, nine rebounds, 3.7 assists, 2.22 blocks and 1.27 steals, while appearing in 81 games in his first season with Charlotte.
A first-round pick of the Los Angeles Lakers in 1989, Divac played five years in Yugoslavia's top league prior to his NBA career.
He played the first seven years in the NBA with the Lakers, averaging a career-best 16.0 points and 10.4 rebounds in 1994-95.
